notes: Machine-readable twin of INSTALL.md. Keep both in sync. status values: documented = commands taken from the repo README; unverified = taken from vendor docs or search results, never run on the host; planned = not available yet. Release assets are built by .github/workflows/release.yml; a route that uses one is only usable once a published release lists it.

after_install.description: Source route only. dist/ folders are build output and are not in git, so every route that installs from the repository must build once. Skip this when runtime/bundle/index.mjs exists (release archive).
after_install.locate_plugin_root: The folder that contains scripts/bootstrap.mjs and .mcp.json. Search for it; do not guess.

workbuddy.label: WorkBuddy
steps: add the GitHub repository as a plugin marketplace through the WorkBuddy interface
workbuddy.fallback: Add the two MCP servers from .mcp.json to ~/.workbuddy/mcp.json (no leading dot before workbuddy), using absolute paths.

claude-desktop.label: Claude Desktop
steps: download the .mcpb from the releases page
double-click it, or drag it onto the Claude Desktop window
leave the two optional settings as they are, or fill in the Zotero key in the masked field
claude-desktop.covers: Zotero tools only. Not the three skills and not the full-text tools.
claude-desktop.note: Built and validated with the mcpb CLI by CI; not yet installed in Claude Desktop, and the Node version it ships is unconfirmed (the bundle asks for 22.13 or newer). If the releases page does not list the file, say so.

release_archive.requires: Node.js 22.13 or newer on the computer, except for Claude Desktop
release_archive.keys: Key setup (scripts/onboard.mjs) is not in the archive, so the skills skip it. Search, ranking and writing need no key; saving to Zotero does, so use the source route for that until a setup page opened by the tools exists.
release_archive.note: Use the extracted folder wherever a host route names the GitHub address. Built and checked by CI; not yet tested through any host. If the latest release does not list the file, use the source route and say so.

source.locate_plugin_root: The folder that contains scripts/bootstrap.mjs and .mcp.json. Search for it; do not guess.

not_in_any_route.database-browser-runtime: Optional. Source route only, on request. Chromium (a few hundred MB, about 540 MB on disk on macOS) is downloaded on first use, only after the user agrees, through the database_browser_install tool. See database-browser-runtime/README.md.
